Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
CAMARILLA CONCLAVE 2017

Honorable Kindred of the civilised world:

In these fateful times for our lineage, we have to face the constant loss of followers. This fatal bleeding must be stopped at once. That is why the most exalted members of the Inner Circle of the Camarilla have decided to hold their Conclave on the 12th of November 2017 in Palma de Mallorca (Spain). Its main purpose will be the appointment of eight new Justicars (more capable than the current ones) to put an end to this situation that endangers our very existence.

We hope to see you all in Palma de Mallorca on the 12th of November, so that you can prove us you truly deserve the titles of Justicars.

Do not fail us, for the wrath of the Inner Circle will know no boundaries.

TOURNAMENT INFORMATION:

Event Date: 12th-November-2017
Event Location: Club Desperta Ferro (C. Armador Valentí, 23)
City: Palma de Mallorca
Country: Spain
Event Coordinators: Ginés Quiñonero (aka Damnans)
Oganizers: Club Desperta Ferro
Head Judge: Ginés Quiñonero
Multi-judge system: Yes
Format: Standard Constructed
# of rounds: 3+F
Time limit per round: 2 hours
Final round time limit: 2 hours
Start time: 10 a.m.
Entry fee: 6 euros

PRIZES AND PUNISHMENTS

8 Justicar 3D-printed deck boxes:
The top 8 players will be appointed Justicars. The winner will choose his or her Justicar title and deck box first. The other finalists will receive their titles and deck boxes at random. Then the 6th ranked player will choose his Justicar title and deck box, and so on:

The available titles are:

-Assamite Justicar
-Brujah Justicar
-Gangrel Justicar
-Malkavian Justicar
-Nosferatu Justicar
-Toreador Justicar
-Tremere Justicar
-Ventrue Justicar

3 Anathema prizes: A 3D-printed box for blood counters
The Inner Circle of the Camarilla will not tolerate those who fail, so 3 of the 5 lowest seeded vampires after the third round will be declared Anathema, and will be included on the Red List, together with the kindred most wanted.

The 5 lowest seeded players will play an alternative final. The winner will be declared Anathema Maximum, and 2 other finalists will be randomly declared Anathema Maius and Anathema Magnum, respectively.

The winner of the Camarilla Conclave will also get this 3D-printed edge:
